body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/38673
Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/595

## What changed

- Reproduced the missing `lm_head_is_tied` state in the checked-out `Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration` constructor and inherited first-forward path.
- Store the same tied-head decision used by `Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration`, including the CPU AMX case where the head must be materialized rather than aliased.
- When a tied checkpoint uses a materialized head, copy the embedding weight into `lm_head` during unified weight loading.
- Add a regression based on a small real Transformers `Gemma4UnifiedConfig` covering tied and untied construction, tied and untied loading, numerical first forward, and GPU graph capture/replay.
- Add the required result report and raw test/GPU evidence under `reports/j-1a400177cb9a/`.

## Reproduction and validation

Failing before the fix:

```bash
HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1a400177cb9a/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/models/test_gemma4_unified_lm_head.py
```

The regression failed with `AttributeError: 'Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration' object has no attribute 'lm_head_is_tied'`.

Passing after the fix with the same command:

```text
5 passed, 17 warnings in 12.67s
```

The GPU cases ran on the one assigned AMD Instinct MI350X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and included `torch.cuda.CUDAGraph` capture/replay plus logits comparisons against direct matrix multiplication.

## Limitations

The original `google/gemma-4-12B-it` startup was **not exercised** because gated model weights were not downloaded. The focused regression substitutes heavyweight decoder components while retaining the actual unified constructor, loader, inherited forward, a real small Gemma4 Unified configuration, and real GPU graph machinery. Multi-process pipeline parallel execution and a physical CPU AMX host were not available. No native code changed or required rebuilding. Ruff was not available in the prepared interpreter; Python compilation and `git diff --check` passed.
